scheme_name: Scholarship (I to VIII Standard) by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
other_conditions: The beneficiary must be a student.
The beneficiary must be a differently‑abled person.
The beneficiary must be studying in class 1st to 8th standard.
The beneficiary must be studying in government‑recognized schools.
The beneficiary should not be receiving similar assistance from other sources.
benefits_summary: Scholarship for purchase of books and notebooks: ₹1,000 per annum for classes 1‑5 and ₹3,000 per annum for classes 6‑8.
